message.content:
This editorial illustration depicts a cover for the magazine TEMPO. At the top, the large red word "TEMPO" is printed, with smaller white text above and below it. The main visual features a large, disembodied human hand in a dark suit jacket and white cuff extending from the left. This hand holds a grey, metal-colored wind-up key that is inserted into the back of a standing man on the right.

The standing man wears red judicial robes with a black collar, black trousers, black shoes, a black songkok hat, and glasses. He holds a small brown wooden gavel in his right hand. The man is shown in profile, looking slightly upward.

The bottom left contains bold black text: "BABAK-BELUR MAHKAMAH KONSTITUSI," followed by smaller black text and "H.38." Additional text at the top reads "Starlink Menggoyang Pasar Internet H.90" and "Sungai Suap Syahrul Yasin Limpo H.78." The bottom footer includes a barcode, a QR code, the date "20-26 MEI 2024," and "RP 50.000." The background is a solid off-white color.
